bootstrap.moonraker_trusted_client: 127.0.0.1 only; Moonraker is never reachable outside the printer

bootstrap.account_verification_path: HTTP Basic login through the loopback-only SSH tunnel
bootstrap.lan_activation_after_verified_login: switch from authenticated loopback nginx to authenticated private-LAN nginx on 0.0.0.0:4409

pre_change_backup: read-only proof that /dev/log is a socket and stock syslogd is active with bounded BusyBox defaults
existence and SHA-256 of every target path
absence markers for new paths that do not exist
validation_without_machine_motion: all staged and installed hashes match
nginx account exists before LAN port 4409 opens
anonymous Mainsail access returns HTTP 401 before and after LAN activation
HTTP Basic credentials are removed before nginx proxies a request to Moonraker
Mainsail login succeeds through the SSH tunnel before LAN activation
screen, Klipper and both CFS processes remain present
no heater, movement, homing, calibration, extrusion or print is started
nginx uses the existing bounded syslog path and Moonraker logs stay below the manifest limit

rollback.trigger: any failed checksum, login, service, coexistence or resource gate
actions: restore prior service files or their recorded absence
restore the prior current-link destination or its recorded absence
remove the project root only when the same capture proves that it was absent before installation
retain the local evidence and pinned source bundle instead of relying on a failed remote release
verify Creality listeners and processes against the pre-change snapshot
rollback.orca_action: none because the active Orca profile remains untouched
